svg.title: All features — map legend
svg.desc: Concept 02 Orienteering Course: the features menu as a map legend; stage-2 items not yet surveyed.
svg.text: Every feature is a legend entry with the symbol it uses on screen. The flow runs as a course: start, controls, finish.
Find a feature, part or location
Start page · reopen exactly as left
Upload three files or reuse an import
Parts and locations, from any screen
Undo the latest move; reset asks first
Movement class and picks, manual move
Occupied or empty, best, Walk Path
Two parts with 5 or more shared jobs
Mark an aisle, a level or a location
Per aisle, import against planning copy
Print view, round order, tick boxes
Opens after the milestone 2 gate. The core flow
